utterances.speaker: Sol
utterances.text: Wait, where do these steps go when they disappear into the floor?

utterances.speaker: Narrator
utterances.text: They turn underneath and ride back to the bottom. Same steps, one big loop.

utterances.speaker: Narrator
utterances.text: An electric motor turns toothed wheels that pull a chain along each side of the steps.

utterances.speaker: Narrator
utterances.text: Front and back rollers follow separate tracks, keeping the surface you stand on level as the step climbs.

utterances.speaker: Narrator
utterances.text: Near the top, the tracks bring neighboring steps to the same height, forming a flat surface before the steps turn underneath.

utterances.speaker: Sol
utterances.text: So the step I just rode comes back around for the next person?
